question: Does retaining the source water coordinate during fixed-target scaffolding improve its recovery after sequence design and independent unconditioned complex prediction?
scope: A prospective native conditioning ablation yielding at most 8 new computational candidates. The source baseline already contains the water; this is not Atlas-versus-direct efficacy, MD, a reaction simulation or an activity prediction.
status: Assignments frozen before generation; corrected native chemical and full-build mask acceptance passed both arms without model execution. Paid execution remains separately authorized.

source_basis.source_derived_motif: Prior run abeta/design_input/ALQSSWGMMG78.pdb; original hybrid motif from author round1_example.ipynb cells7/8/17
source_basis.assay_target: TableS4 ALQSSWGMMGML; intended G7-M8 supported by TableS2 product mass. Adding M11/L12 is our declared prospective adaptation, not author execution replay.
source_basis.source_rules: Predetermined peptide identity; only P1/P1prime backbone fixed; five protein catalytic residues and Zn/water motif preserved.

shared_input.length_basis: Native full build confirms A187/B12: 14 source A motif residues plus173 fixed gap residues makes A187; B12 gives total199. All five gap sizes lie within source ranges.
shared_input.preserve: Original ZnO component name, O1/ZN1 atoms and source coordinates preserved. Prospective explicit PDB Zn charge columns2+ correct the native charge0 interpretation; O1 remains neutral with no invented heavy-atom bond. Source ori_token unchanged. All nonreactive peptide coordinates start unfixed, including added M11/L12.

water_fixed.meaning: Zn and water coordinates retained as in source-constrained baseline.

water_coordinate_free.meaning: Zn remains fixed; only water O1 coordinate conditioning is released. The water atom/species remains present and its chemical graph is unchanged.

input_changes: Explicit PDB Zn formal charge2+; original blank charge parsed0. This is prospective chemistry encoding, not recovery of author settings.
Public rangeA28-30 replaces source-styleA28-A30, which released onlyA28. All nine intended A residues are now sequence-unfixed.
verified: Both Zn+2 and neutral O retained, no Zn-O heavy bond
Only O1 fixed-coordinate annotation differs; native masking then zeroes only O1 starting coordinates. All other coordinates and annotations match.
native_acceptance.recheck: The remote runtime reruns the actual native load/build and pair verifier before weights are acquired. No substituted parser body.

rfd3.checkpoint: rfd3_foundry_2025_12_01_remapped.ckpt; record identical content hash for all8
rfd3.command_rule: One native invocation per arm/seed so each arm starts from the assigned RNG seed; retain all8 assignments, structures and native metadata. Do not choose a best output or retry an unfavorable design.

sequence_design.checkpoint: Official ligandmpnn_v_32_010_25.pt; record identical content hash
sequence_design.fixed_residues: Exactly native-verified A36,A37,A40,A115,A152 plus B1 through B12. Before MPNN weights load, use MPNNInferenceInput to verify all five A residues and all B residues are fixed, while every other A residue is designed. Do not mix residue and chain selectors.
sequence_design.budget: One full enzyme sequence per assigned backbone; no best-of or extra temperature sweep. Verify all five catalytic identities and unchanged12mer after sampling.
sequence_design.qualification: Public LigandMPNN substitutes for the author EnhancedMPNN configuration; both arms use the same implementation. Generated sequences are not source constructs or validated enzymes.

independent_evaluation.consumer: Pinned RF3, same checkpoint/features for all candidates; source-defined native chemistry gate first.
independent_evaluation.inputs: For each full generated enzyme sequence, predict monomer and enzyme+unchanged12mer+[Zn+2].O. No RFD3 coordinates, templates, MSA or motif restraints supplied.
independent_evaluation.accounting: 8 candidates x2 states x5 outputs; no replacement candidates or rescue seeds. Structure draws share a trunk pass; the four design-seed pairs, not40 ES structures, are the comparison units.
independent_evaluation.missing_MACE: If descriptors remain absent, retain the official supported absence path and disclose it identically for both arms; no claim of equivalence to descriptor-present inference.

primary_readout.name: Recovery error of the source water position after independent ES prediction
primary_readout.definition: Fit a proper rigid transform from the predicted Zn, first source-histidine NE2 and second source-histidine NE2 to the corresponding3 non-water source-motif atoms. Apply that transform to predicted water O; report its Euclidean distance in angstrom from source water O. Do not use water in the alignment. Preserve the3-anchor fit residual and reject undefined/degenerate frames as missing.
primary_readout.summary: For each generated candidate retain all5 ES errors and their median. For each assigned design seed report median(error_fixed)-median(error_free).
primary_readout.decision: With all40 valid ES outputs and complete four design-seed pairs: all4 differences<0 supports consistent water-position recovery benefit in this small computational experiment; all4>0 supports the reverse; mixed signs, ties or any missing/invalid ES assignment establishes no consistent advantage. All40 assigned monomer outputs remain essential context and their missingness is reported separately; they do not silently change the ES primary denominator. No significance test, activity inference or post-result threshold.

essential_context: Report monomer/ES backbone agreement to the generated scaffold and native confidence, together with the existing Zn-ligand, Zn-water, base-water, water-C-O angle, donor-carbonyl and amide-register measurements for every ES output. Unusually short contacts remain visible and cannot count as chemically productive merely because primary recovery error is low. Reference-motif recovery is not a catalytic barrier or a validated kinetic proxy.
biochemical_connection: If later wet work is authorized, retain all8 assigned candidates for matched purification/concentration assessment and a product-resolved G7-M8 initial-rate comparison, with source TDPn3 as positive reference and no-enzyme/buffer controls. Verify the intended products directly before calling a fluorescence change cleavage. Compare activity at matched enzyme/substrate conditions and retain failed expression/solubility as missing functional data, not resample replacements. Follow a positive signal with substrate-dependent rates and an independently assessed catalytic-site or metal-dependence control. Report apparent kcat if active fraction is unknown; KM is not binding Kd. No gene ordering, outreach or lab execution is included now.
stopping: Stop before generation on a failed native chemistry/mask gate; stop an affected assignment on unmappable catalytic residues or altered target identity. Keep the assigned denominator. Finish the finite8-candidate/80-output comparison without a rescue search. A physical protonation diagnostic may run independently but is not a prerequisite to this bounded generation experiment.

run_bounds.prospective_request: One A100 GPU, no more than2 hours rental time and $5 total. No current rental is implied. Root handles approval/provider lifecycle.
run_bounds.hard_limit: Root separately stops instance before paid cap, reserves retrieval time and retains all partial outputs.
